description:
Creates a fresh server-identified group and its leader atomically.
Use when: the player explicitly confirms the group settings.
Not for: choosing/reusing a group ID or resending uncertain writes with a new revision.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken. The current MyGroupsView revision.
Side effects: Creates one group and membership within both limits. The retained player revision prevents duplicate creation on replay.
Returns: {groups:MyGroupsView,group:GroupView|null}. groups is the actor's complete snapshot, never the target's private state. group is null after leave/delete; nonmembers never receive private data. Replace only the matching host/project/player cache.
Errors: Use horizon_get_groups and horizon_get_group_pending to reconcile state. 409 REVISION_CONFLICT or uncertain response: read and reconcile intent, never refresh the revision and repeat automatically. Pending decisions require the original requestId; REQUEST_NOT_FOUND means it was removed/replaced. INBOX_FULL rolls back the entire action. 403 rejects group role, session or bilateral block violations. 429 is reported without automatic retry. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

data.description: Required finite JSON object; current maxDataBytes/maxDataDepth are server policies. Client JSON bytes can differ from stored dataJson after number normalization; the server validates the complete stored representation. No default2048-byte/depth16 clamp. Only members/admins can read it.

expectedPlayerRevision.description: Exact reviewed revision; never replace automatically after an uncertain response

joinMode.description: Whether players join directly, request admission or need an invitation

name.description: Nonblank display name under current maxNameBytes; server enforces the complete BSON envelope

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken, sent only in Authorization

userId.description: Signed-in player matching the Bearer session

name: horizon_create_group
title: Create Group
